description: The built data of every perk: name, category, group, active flag, explicitly set icon, force affinity, hotbar modes, perk-wide stat bonuses and the number of levels. Delegates are listed by name when set but their bodies are not locked.
inputs: 504 perks sorted by perk id. Stat bonuses are Stat=value for no creature ("engine" if the bonus needs the engine). Icon is only what the definition set explicitly (null otherwise); the rest come from feat.2da at load time. Perk descriptions are always unset; the text lives on the levels.
